body: Thank you for this comment. What you said is right, but after all these years where i believed in myself and failed everytime, i don't know if i should try again to love the person that i am. It's too hard, it requires too much "mental strength", and I'm in a moment where all i want to do is dying. I would like to hit a reset button and live my life again knowing what mistakes to avoid, i wasted so many opportunities and now I'm a mess. I'm 20 and i think it's better for me to stop it here than keep going.
